Round to nearest integer? They said "only fill integer volume; if not integer round". So we round 10.036 to 10 gallons. Then call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount=10. Then startEngine with ignitionMode="START". Then lockDoors with unlock=false, door list all four? They didn't specify which doors, but likely all. Then activateParkingBrake with mode="engage". Also maybe check if fuel tank capacity is 50 gallons. 10 gallons is fine.

We need to call functions in order. We'll do fillFuelTank, then startEngine, lockDoors, activateParkingBrake.
